units.source_text: 是父母担心会从邻居那儿传到千重子的耳朵里才先坦白出来的呢，

en.t: Was it because her parents feared she would hear it from the neighbors that they confessed it to her first,

units.source_text: 还是父母相信千重子对他们的爱是深厚的，

en.t: or because they trusted that Chieko's love for them was deep,

units.source_text: 或是多少考虑到千重子已经到了明辨事理的年龄呢？

en.t: or had they considered, at least somewhat, that Chieko was already old enough to understand right from wrong?
